init.title: Home Maintenance Manager

configure_notifications.title: Maintenance notifications
configure_notifications.description: Choose whether to receive individual task reminders, a daily maintenance summary, or both. The next step will show only the settings needed for your choices.

data_description.individual_notifications_enabled: Send reminders for individual tasks as they approach their due dates or become overdue.
data_description.daily_summary_enabled: Send one daily message summarizing maintenance that is due soon or overdue.

manage_tasks.title: Maintenance task selection
manage_tasks.description: Select tasks by expanding a category. Use Select all or Clear all at the top, then finish to configure intervals.

intervals.title: Maintenance intervals
intervals.description: Choose a category to set the interval for each selected recurring task. Seasonal tasks use their season windows instead.

configure_automatic_backups.title: Automatic JSON backups
configure_automatic_backups.description: Choose whether backups run automatically, how often they run, the local time, and how many automatic backups to retain. Manual backups and pre-restore safety backups are never removed by automatic retention.

data.automatic_backup_retention: Number of automatic backups to keep (1–100)

data_description.automatic_backups_enabled: Turn scheduled JSON backups on or off. Manual backups remain available when this is disabled.
data_description.automatic_backup_frequency: Choose daily, weekly on Sunday, or monthly on the first day of the month.
data_description.automatic_backup_time: Local Home Assistant time when the scheduled backup starts, using 24-hour HH:MM format.
data_description.automatic_backup_retention: Maximum number of automatic backups to keep. Older automatic backups are deleted; manual and pre-restore safety backups are not.

configure_update_backups.title: Update-triggered backups
configure_update_backups.description: Optionally create a Home Maintenance Manager JSON backup when selected update entities report an available update, and track when their installation starts. Leave the entity list empty to monitor all update entities. An availability backup may be created well before installation; installation tracking cannot guarantee a backup finishes before an update starts.

data.update_backup_on_available: Create a JSON backup when an update becomes available
data.update_install_tracking_enabled: Notify when a monitored update starts installing
data.update_backup_entities: Update entities to monitor (empty means all update entities)

data_description.update_backup_on_available: Create a Home Maintenance Manager JSON backup when a monitored update entity reports that an update is available. This may happen well before installation.
data_description.update_install_tracking_enabled: Record when a monitored update starts installing and send a persistent notification. This does not pause the update or guarantee a backup completes first.
data_description.update_backup_entities: Choose the Home Assistant update entities to monitor. Leave the selection empty to monitor all update entities.
